name: zrndr_span_alpha_blend_565_from_pal8_alpha8
description: zRndr::SpanAlphaBlend565FromPal8Alpha8 expands 8-bit texture indices through the active palette and blends them into a 5:6:5 destination span using per-texel alpha-map coverage.
known_limits: VC5SP3 byte verification currently fails: original 0x49d1a0 is 524 bytes, the compiled source loop is 304 bytes, 56 relocation bytes are masked, 10 trailing VC NOPs are trimmed, and 460 unmasked byte mismatches remain.

The mismatch is explained by source-shape/codegen limits: the source preserves the verified odd-pixel head and paired 5:6:5 behavior through shared index/blend helpers, but VC5SP3 emits helper calls, different stack/register allocation, and a different paired-loop shape instead of the retail routine's fully inlined packed blend.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x49d1a0 validates paletted 8-bit texel sampling from g_spanActiveTexels, palette expansion through g_spanActiveTexPalette, alpha-map lookup from g_spanActiveTexAlphaMap, source index construction from texU >> 20 plus masked texV shifted by texVShift, and destination advancement.
The original handles an odd-pixel head first, skips alpha values below 8, copies palette color for alpha values at least 248, then blends paired 5:6:5 pixels using packed masks and alpha >> 3.
The native smoke verifies odd-pixel blending, full-copy paired output, packed pair blending, low-alpha paired skip, and that g_spanCurrentDst16 is not advanced by the source-faithful implementation.
